title: Stay at Home
subtitle: 考点：生病时的建议 / If you have the flu, you should stay at home.

dialogue.t: Tom, you look tired. Do you feel well?
No, Mum. I have a headache and I cough.
I think you have the flu. Let me check your temperature.
Yes. If you have the flu, you should stay at home and rest.
But I want to go to school.
No. You should drink water and take enough rest. I will call your teacher.

vocab: flu 流感 · stay 待 · rest 休息 · check 检查 · enough 足够的 · should 应该 · house 房子

questions.why: I think you have the flu.
You should stay at home and rest.
